text:
Alex: Morning handoff — quick notes before I head out.

Alex: TL;DR: embeds batch size bump rolled, restart completed in eu-west, watch the embed queue tail latency. If it stays high open an incident and ping @Sam.

Sam: On it. I'll validate the batch config PR (link: https://github.com/redwood/embeds/pull/421) and check infra.

Priya: I saw the spike ~09:12 UTC, tail ~2s for ~10m. Tracing points to one host with high egress. I pinned logs to the embeds-oncall thread. No errors in app logs.

Jordan: Maintenance tonight 02:00-02:30 UTC (DB vacuum). No downtime expected but app pods will be restarted in sequence. Rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --namespace=prod`.

Alex: Action items — Sam: validate PR + revert if needed; Priya: keep KV hitrate monitor on (alert if <85%); Jordan: leave the maintenance runbook in Confluence and add contact numbers.

Sam: Quick check — if embeds tail >1.5s for >5m we escalate. Confirm?

Priya: Confirmed. Also FYI: prefetch cache TTL reduced yesterday to 30s in prod; could explain slight tail variability.

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance (DB vacuum) in 4 hours.

Jordan: I'll add a quick runbook snippet here:
```
# runbook excerpt
1. kubectl cordon <node>
2. restart embeds pods: kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeds
3. monitor emb-queue latency: grafana/dashboard/embeds-queue
4. if error rate >1% hit rollback
```

Alex: Thanks — leaving @Sam as primary for the rest of shift, @Priya backup. Ping me if anything escalates :thumbsup:
